item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Lynn Gendusa: Let’s Finally Take the Curtains Down
item.description: “Mama, why do all the people who look like Ruth live in one section of town?” I asked after we drove Miss Ruth home. “I don’t know, honey, but it’s always been this way.” My mother said with a bit of sorrow in her voice. item.title: West Point Rotary hears about fire relief efforts
item.description: After a fire left 19 people homeless in West Point, the West Point Rotary hears how churches, city officials and aid groups rallied to provide emergency relief.

item.title: LaGrange High School debuts ‘Matilda the Musical’
item.description: LaGrange High School brings Broadway favorite “Matilda the Musical” to the stage this week, with a 55-student cast and performances Thursday through Sunday.

item.title: Dennis honored as TC3 Teacher of the Year
item.description: After 38 years of teaching math and science in Troup County, Teresa Dennis is named TC3 Teacher of the Year, celebrated for building students' confidence and perseverance.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Bill King: The Winter Storm of ‘93

item.title: Athlete of the week: Sheniyah Philpot is putting together a dominant senior season
item.description: It's Sheniyah Philpot’s year. The Troup High senior has long since etched her name into the athletic lore at the school, but continues to add to her legacy in her senior season. item.title: Philpot drops 39 to lead Troup past Upson-Lee on senior night
item.description: The Tigers are scorching hot. item.title: Troup outlasts Upson-Lee rally on senior night
item.description: The Troup boys basketball team put together a wire-to-wire win on senior night, edging out Upson-Lee 66-61. It was a big region win for the Tigers, who lost to the Knights on the road earlier in the season. It looked like the Tigers would run away with the game early when they scored the opening 11 points of the game.
